impact.text: An attacker can permanently steal the user's underlying assets during the withdrawal or redemption process.

precondition_sources.text: The user creates an approval via permit, which is executed by the settlement.
The user submits a redeem request to the vault.

intent_sources.text: When redeem or withdraw is called with an owner parameter, the caller must be sufficiently controlled against msg.sender so that a party other than the owner cannot redeem or withdraw the owner's position to an arbitrary receiver.
